```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cmdstanr)
library(here)

df_contrasts <- readRDS(here("outputs", "df_contrasts.rds"))
```

# Construction
Binary covariates are coded (−0.5, +0.5); ASJP is centred on the estimation sample. Then \(\mu_d\) is a grand-mean effect, comparable to the base model.

```{r}
raw_vars <- c(
  age_c     = "age_c",
  vocab_c   = "vocab_type",
  typical_c = "infant_typical",
  proc_c    = "assessment_procedure",
  asjp_c    = "asjp_dist"
)

add_coded <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      vocab_c   = if_else(vocab_type == "expressive", 0.5, -0.5),
      typical_c = if_else(infant_typical, 0.5, -0.5),
      proc_c    = if_else(assessment_procedure == "direct", 0.5, -0.5),
      asjp_c    = asjp_dist - mean(asjp_dist, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

build_stan_data <- function(df_contrasts, formula = ~ 1) {
  covars <- all.vars(formula)
  raw_needed <- unique(map_chr(covars, \(v) if (v %in% names(raw_vars)) raw_vars[[v]] else v))
  if (length(raw_needed) > 0) {
    df_contrasts <- df_contrasts |> drop_na(all_of(raw_needed))
    df_contrasts <- add_coded(df_contrasts)
    key_all <- sort(unique(c(
      paste(df_contrasts$short_cite, df_contrasts$ppt_trt),
      paste(df_contrasts$short_cite, df_contrasts$ppt_ref)
    )))
    df_contrasts <- df_contrasts |>
      mutate(
        study_id   = as.integer(factor(short_cite)),
        ppt_trt_id = match(paste(short_cite, ppt_trt), key_all),
        ppt_ref_id = match(paste(short_cite, ppt_ref), key_all),
        paired     = as.integer(ppt_trt_id == ppt_ref_id)
      )
  }

  X <- model.matrix(formula, data = df_contrasts)
  X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), "(Intercept)"), drop = FALSE]
  
  if (nrow(df_contrasts) != nrow(X)) {
    stop("Mismatch in nrow between df_contrasts and X")
  }
  
  N_ppt <- max(c(df_contrasts$ppt_trt_id, df_contrasts$ppt_ref_id))
  
  list(
    N_obs      = nrow(df_contrasts),
    N_study    = n_distinct(df_contrasts$study_id),
    N_ppt      = N_ppt,
    K          = 4L,
    P          = ncol(X),
    
    y          = df_contrasts$y,
    se_y       = df_contrasts$se_y,
    
    arm_trt    = df_contrasts$arm_trt,
    arm_ref    = df_contrasts$arm_ref,
    study_id   = df_contrasts$study_id,
    ppt_trt_id = df_contrasts$ppt_trt_id,
    ppt_ref_id = df_contrasts$ppt_ref_id,
    paired     = df_contrasts$paired,
    
    X          = X
  )
}

mod <- cmdstan_model("nma_bilingual.stan")
```

# Fitting
```{r}
model_specs <- list(
  base                  = ~ 1,
  # age                   = ~ age_c,
  # vocab_type            = ~ vocab_c,
  # infant_typical        = ~ typical_c,
  # assessment_procedure  = ~ proc_c,
  # asjp_dist             = ~ asjp_c,
  full                  = ~ age_c + vocab_c + typical_c + proc_c + asjp_c
)

fit_dir <- here("outputs", "stan")
dir.create(fit_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

fit_one <- function(spec_formula, name) {
  stan_data <- build_stan_data(df_contrasts, spec_formula)
  mod$sample(
    data            = stan_data,
    seed            = 42,
    chains          = 4,
    parallel_chains = 4,
    iter_warmup     = 1000,
    iter_sampling   = 2000,
    adapt_delta     = 0.95,
    output_dir      = fit_dir,
    output_basename = name
  )
}

fits <- imap(model_specs, fit_one)
saveRDS(fits, here("outputs", "fits.rds"))
```
